response.justification: While Bogdan demonstrates strong software engineering fundamentals, diverse technical expertise, and commitment to best practices, he falls critically short on the essential minimum qualifications for this role. Most significantly, he has only approximately one year of professional C++ experience versus the required eight years—a fundamental mismatch for leading a cloud compute platform requiring systems-level C++ expertise. Additionally, his large-scale infrastructure experience spans only 2-3 years compared to the required five years, and he lacks formal technical leadership experience managing or mentoring engineering teams. His career has focused on polyglot application development and web services rather than systems-level cloud architecture.
strengths: Extensive technical breadth across multiple languages and platforms demonstrating strong adaptability and problem-solving abilities
Proven commitment to software craftsmanship with demonstrated experience in testing practices, CI/CD pipelines, and engineering best practices
Hands-on experience with distributed systems at scale, including micro-services infrastructure handling millions of HTTP requests per second at Dunnhumby
concerns: Critical deficiency in C++ programming with only ~1 year professional experience against the required 8 years, essential for systems-level cloud compute platform development
Insufficient large-scale infrastructure and distributed systems experience (2-3 years) falling significantly short of the required 5 years
No formal technical leadership experience managing or mentoring engineers; background is primarily in knowledge-sharing through workshops rather than line management
